steps.text: Hey 😊 Quick important question before I go back: apple tart or chocolate?
Apple tart
Good, that's what I was hoping you'd say
Was this ever really a choice?
You were allowed to agree with me 😌
How's your afternoon going?
Nearly through the last batch of paperwork
Still leaving at five, I'm not letting a folder steal our evening
I haven't started cooking yet, you've got time
I know, I just want to get out on time for once
I'll let you finish then
I'll text you when I leave ❤️
Shortly before five, in the manager's office...

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: I'm supposed to be looking forward to seeing {{name:lena}} tonight. Instead, every update from that office pulls me back to last night.

steps.text: Finished?
The updated totals are in your inbox, and the signed copies are in this folder
Bring them over, I don't bite
I can leave a folder on a desk without instructions
There she is. You've hardly said a word to me all day
I've been thinking about how last night ended
So have I
Not like that
You're going to tell me you didn't enjoy it?
I did. That's not the problem
I went home and talked to him like nothing had happened
It was a kiss, not a marriage proposal
He wouldn't see it that way
He wasn't there
That doesn't make it better
You weren't nearly this worried outside the bar
I should've been
And I kissed you back that even worse
Then stop trying to talk yourself out of having enjoyed it
I'm not. I just feel bad about what i did and that I'm keeping it from him
Who cares what he thinks? You kissed me, and you liked it. That's all that matters
I don't want to hurt him
You won't. You can still be with him and have a good time with me
I don't know if I can do that
You can. You just have to want to
Come have a drink with me when you're done
No, I'm seeing him tonight
Dinner?
Dinner and a film. I told him I'd be there around six
Very domestic
It's something I want to do, you don't have to make it sound boring
You can see me another night
You could try not deciding that for me
I know you'd have a good time
You never get tired of hearing yourself, do you?
Not when I'm right
I'm leaving now
You know where to find me
I work here. It would be difficult not to

steps.title: HAK//NOTICE
messages: {{name:lena}} picks up her bag and moves toward the office door
Her manager look at her ass as she leaves

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: She's leaving, and I finally let out the breath I've been holding. Even now, I hate the way he watches her go.

steps.text: At five, outside the office...
Five o'clock, I'm out ❤️
All finished?
Enough for today, I've left the rest where it belongs
At work?
Where it can bother someone else for an hour 😌
Stopping for the tart, then coming over
Take your time, the food isn't on yet
After a quick stop at the bakery...
They had two slices left. I consider that excellent planning
You got lucky
Please don't ruin my very organised girlfriend image 😭
Keep the box upright, that's all I'm asking
It's getting a better seat on the bus than I am
See you around six ❤️
See you soon
